name: Linocut
description: Linocut gouges: broad chisel strokes with rounded ends.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: @svg(viewBox: 0 0 100 100; rect*4 { x: calc(@n(-1) * 25 + 5); y: 6; width: 14; height: 88; rx: 7; fill: #000 }); mask: @svg(viewBox: 0 0 100 100; rect*4 { x: calc(@n(-1) * 25 + 5); y: 6; width: 14; height: 88; rx: 7; fill: #000 }); -webkit-transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 90deg)); transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 90deg)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
